group: Successful validation – simple schema

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == true and no ValidationMessage objects
cases.description: Walks a node that conforms to a simple schema (type object with required string property "name"). The method should return a successful ValidationResult.

group: Validation failure – type mismatch

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == false and ValidationMessage contains a message about missing required property "name"
cases.description: The node does not satisfy the required property constraint of the schema, causing the walkAtNode method to collect an error.

group: Validation disabled – should skip validation

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == true and no ValidationMessage objects (validation skipped)
cases.description: When the `validate` flag is false the method should bypass all validators and return a successful result.

group: Null node handling

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == false and ValidationMessage contains a message about node being null or missing
cases.description: The method should detect a null instance node and produce a validation error rather than throwing NPE.

group: Recursive anchor handling

input.value: mocked ExecutionContext where JsonSchema.isRecursiveAnchor() returns true

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == true and no infinite recursion occurs (walk terminates correctly)
cases.description: When the schema is marked as a recursive anchor the walkAtNode method must handle the self‑reference without entering an endless loop.

group: Exception handling – UnsupportedEncodingException from InputFormat parsing

input.value: mocked ExecutionContext with a custom InputFormat that throws UnsupportedEncodingException when parsing
JsonNode representing any JSON (won't be used)

cases.expected: walkAtNode propagates a RuntimeException wrapping UnsupportedEncodingException
cases.description: If an underlying InputFormat fails with UnsupportedEncodingException, walkAtNodeInternal should surface the problem as a runtime exception.

group: Exception handling – IOException from schema loading

input.value: mocked ExecutionContext where schema retrieval throws IOException

cases.expected: walkAtNode propagates a RuntimeException wrapping IOException
cases.description: When the schema cannot be read (e.g., network error), the method should not swallow the IOException but wrap and re‑throw it.

group: Custom ExecutionContext – consumer modifies context before validation

input.value: mocked ExecutionContext with a mutable flag `skipAll` initially false

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == false and ValidationMessage indicates validation was skipped because consumer set `skipAll` to true
cases.description: When a Consumer<ExecutionContext> customizer is supplied (via the overloaded walkAtNodeInternal), it can change the context to disable validation. The test verifies that the change is respected.

group: Successful validation – $ref to external schema

input.value: mocked ExecutionContext where getSchemaNode for URI "http://example.com/address" returns schema { "type": "object", "properties": { "street": { "type": "string" } }, "required": ["street"] }

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == true and no ValidationMessage objects (the $ref is resolved and the instance satisfies the referenced schema)
cases.description: The schema contains a $ref to an external schema (address). The ExecutionContext is mocked to provide that schema. walkAtNode should resolve the reference, apply the referenced validators, and return a successful result.

group: Validation failure – $ref to external schema with missing required property

input.value: mocked ExecutionContext where getSchemaNode for URI "http://example.com/address" returns schema { "type": "object", "properties": { "street": { "type": "string" } }, "required": ["street"] }

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == false and ValidationMessage contains a message about missing required property "street" in the referenced schema
cases.description: The $ref resolves to a schema that requires "street". The instance lacks this property, so walkAtNode must report the missing‑property error coming from the referenced schema.

group: Successful validation – enum constraint

input.value: mocked ExecutionContext with default settings (schema contains enum ["red","green","blue"])

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == true and no ValidationMessage objects
cases.description: The schema restricts the value to an enum. The provided value matches one of the allowed enum entries, so validation succeeds.

group: Validation failure – enum constraint mismatch

input.value: mocked ExecutionContext with default settings (schema contains enum ["red","green","blue"])

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == false and ValidationMessage contains a message about value not being one of the allowed enum values
cases.description: The instance value is not present in the enum list, so walkAtNode should report an enum violation.

group: Successful validation – oneOf with matching subschema

input.value: mocked ExecutionContext with default settings (schema contains oneOf: [{"type":"string"},{"type":"integer"}])

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == true and no ValidationMessage objects (the integer matches the second subschema)
cases.description: The schema uses oneOf with a string and an integer option. The instance is an integer, so validation should succeed via the matching subschema.

group: Validation failure – oneOf with no matching subschema

input.value: mocked ExecutionContext with default settings (schema contains oneOf: [{"type":"string"},{"type":"integer"}])

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == false and ValidationMessage contains a message about failing oneOf validation
cases.description: The instance is a boolean, which does not satisfy any of the subschemas in the oneOf clause, so walkAtNode must report a oneOf failure.

group: Successful validation – array items validation

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == true and no ValidationMessage objects
cases.description: The schema requires an array of integers. All elements are integers, so validation succeeds.

group: Validation failure – array items type mismatch

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == false and ValidationMessage contains a message about element at index 1 not being an integer
cases.description: One array element violates the items schema (string instead of integer). walkAtNode should report the specific location and type error.

group: Instance location propagation – nested property validation

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == false and ValidationMessage contains instance location "/person/age"
cases.description: The validation error occurs deep inside the instance. walkAtNode must correctly build the JsonNodePath so the message points to "/person/age".

group: Root node differs from node – sub‑node validation

input.value: JsonNode representing "short" (length 5) – this is the sub‑node to validate

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == true and no ValidationMessage objects (validation succeeds on the sub‑node while rootNode is larger)
cases.description: walkAtNode is invoked on a sub‑node (the value of "/title"). The method must use the provided rootNode for $ref resolution but validate only the supplied node, returning a successful result.

group: Configuration – failFast stops after first error

input.value: mocked ExecutionContext with SchemaValidatorsConfig.failFast = true (schema has two failing constraints: required "name" and type integer for "age")

cases.expected: ValidationResult.isValid() == false and exactly one ValidationMessage (the first detected error, e.g., missing required property "name")
cases.description: When failFast is enabled, walkAtNode should abort after the first validation error, not collecting subsequent errors.

group: Null parameter handling – executionContext is null

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown
cases.description: walkAtNode should immediately fail with NPE when the required ExecutionContext argument is null.

group: Null parameter handling – instanceLocation is null

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown
cases.description: The method relies on a non‑null JsonNodePath to build error locations; passing null should cause an NPE.

group: Invalid JsonNodePath – malformed pointer

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException is thrown (malformed JSON Pointer)
cases.description: JsonNodePath internally validates JSON‑Pointer syntax. Supplying a pointer with an illegal '~' escape should trigger an IllegalArgumentException.

group: Unresolvable $ref fragment – IllegalArgumentException

input.value: mocked ExecutionContext where getRefSchemaNode("#/nonexistent") returns null

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException is thrown (cannot resolve $ref fragment)
cases.description: When a $ref points to a fragment that does not exist in the schema, walkAtNode should raise an IllegalArgumentException rather than silently ignoring it.

group: ExecutionContext method throws RuntimeException

input.value: mocked ExecutionContext whose getValidators() throws IllegalStateException("custom failure")

cases.expected: IllegalStateException is propagated
cases.description: If the ExecutionContext encounters an unexpected error while providing validators, walkAtNode must not swallow the exception; it should propagate the original RuntimeException.

group: Schema contains unsupported format – DateTimeParseException wrapped

cases.expected: RuntimeException wrapping DateTimeParseException is thrown
cases.description: When a string fails the built‑in "date-time" format validator, the underlying parser throws DateTimeParseException. walkAtNode should surface this as a RuntimeException (the library wraps format errors in a runtime exception).
